title: T-32 prices part, EVIDENCE only (probe P-T32-PRICES): the host CREATES a pricing-manager plan through the game's own creation path (lever `pricesuggest make`, premise asserted), then after a merge the host and the client each recompute the SUGGESTED prices of that SAME plan (the host's own plan; the client's partner copy of it) the way the pricing screen does on open, and the probe logs each machine's suggestions and the formula's inputs. Report-only: equal or different is the finding, not a pass/fail. Ends dissolved, NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Build with P-T32-PRICES deployed on BOTH machines (Dev build: the `pricesuggest` lever). The fixture has no pricing-manager plan (run T-PRICESUGGEST-20261113-150520 step 13: own=0 partnerRows=0), so step 5 creates one on the host BEFORE the merge, as a player would in BizMan > headquarters > Pricing Managers (PricingManagersPlanList.AddPlan :63-75, AssignEmployee :245, SetSupervisedNeighborhood PricingManagerPlanUI.cs:119). The fixture's host has NO employee with ba:skill_pricingmanager (run T-PRICESUGGEST-20261113-152356 step 5), so steps 5-7 get one the way a player does, BEFORE the plan: step 5 `pricesuggest recruit` runs the recruitment agency campaign's own candidate search (RecruitmentCampaign.CheckForCandidates :58-71 -> RecruitmentHelper.GenerateCandidate, campaign shaped as RecruitmentAgencyDialog.cs:163-176 with business = the rented headquarters; find time now, no fee) and names a free pricing-manager workstation, the first open day and its opening hour; step 6 hires the candidate (`hire`, EmployeeHelper.HireCandidate, address = the headquarters); step 7 puts it on a shift through the Schedule tab (`shiftat`, ScheduleHelper.AddWorkShift as ScheduleEmployeeSelection.cs:60). FIXTURE REQUIREMENT: the host rents a headquarters with an open schedule day and a free workstation suitable for ba:skill_pricingmanager, the city has a recruitment agency, and the host runs at least one manageable (revenue, priced) business; if not, step 5 (or 8) answers ERR naming what is missing and the run stops there. The plan then reaches the client the way any host plan does (CompanyPlans partner rows, BuildPricing); both machines run the lever on the captured id.

steps.expect_result: ^OK pricesuggest recruit candidate=\S+ skill=\S+ day=[1-7] station=\S+ from=\d+ .* hq=\S+ \S+$
steps.note: PREMISE: a ba:skill_pricingmanager candidate for the host's rented headquarters, produced by the recruitment campaign's own candidate search; ERR names a missing headquarters, agency, open day or free workstation
PREMISE: the game's own hire (EmployeeHelper.HireCandidate); the candidate keeps the headquarters address the campaign gave it
PREMISE: the new pricing manager on a work shift at the headquarters, through the Schedule tab's own ScheduleHelper.AddWorkShift (a headquarters desk shift spans the opening slot on every open day)

PREMISE: the host creates its own plan (game's own creation path) BEFORE the merge, so only the host's own employees and shops are candidates; manager= is expected to be the employee hired at step 6 unless the save already had a free one; suggestions>=1 asserts the supervised shops have products
waits for the client's own settle line (searched from the previous step) instead of a fixed sleep
the HOST's own plan made at step 8, recomputed as the pricing screen does on open (PricingManagerPlanUI.LoadPlan:47)
the CLIENT's copy of the same plan (CompanyPlans partner row), recomputed from the client's own data exactly as its screen would

steps.cmd: mark T32 PRICES REPORT plan=${t32Plan} nb=${madeNeighborhood} stores=${madeStores} host skill=${hostSkill} stores=${hostStores} n=${hostCount} sugg=${hostSugg} | client skill=${clientSkill} stores=${clientStores} n=${clientCount} sugg=${clientSugg}
steps.note: REPORT ONLY: writes both machines' captured suggestions side by side into both logs; equality is NOT asserted (evidence for T-32). The per-product inputs are the [PROBE T32-PRICES] product lines of steps 17/18
FIXTURE HYGIENE: end dissolved; NO save
